title: 第2章 战锤大转盘
slug: 我在战锤抽词条帝皇站起来了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林恩这辈子没有跑得这么快过。

真的，不夸张，真的。

被体育老师追上最多被踹一脚。

被拿着刀的混沌教徒追上就^%&*#@……啊啊啊啊啊！！！

还有会吃人的混沌邪物。

林恩边逃边飙泪：“战锤40k——！！！是战锤40k——！！！”

战锤！！！！！！

他穿到战锤了！！！！！！

在网上刷锤梗的时候大家“哈哈哈忠诚！”，“俺不忠嘞！”，“色孽！”，“准备跳帮！天降正义！”，“你爹来了，逆贼受死！”……

那是坐在家里，电脑前，手边有可乐，角色随时跳劈大比兜，随时可以关掉游戏回到现实的时候。

真到了这一天，本人站在一个黑不溜秋的洞穴里，身后七八个CUltiSt和一群奇形怪状的混沌邪物追，前面不知道还有没有路——

你来试试看啊啊啊啊啊——！！！！！

身后传来CUltiSt带着笑意像是猫在玩老鼠之前发出的那种声音。

“他跑不远的。”

“抓住他，献给主人——”

“新鲜的血肉……”

“追——！”

林恩眼泪都飚出来了。

就这么光穿越吗？！！没有金手指吗？！他的金手指在哪啊？！！！

“系统！系统你在吗——！！！”

其实他叫的时候也没抱多大希望的。

要是真的叫什么来什么那还好了。

但是真的就在他绝望逃命的時候，脑袋里突然叮的一下，传来了一个声音。

“叮————！”

就像是有人在他意识里轻轻敲了一下钟。

然后一块虚幻的白色面板在他眼前展开。

系统出声：【……就没见过你这么能嚎的宿主。】

林恩不敢置信：“——什么？！”

【没什么，系统很不高兴为您服务。】

系统换了个官方礼貌假笑语气开始上班：【宿主真的是本系统见到过的最能跑的宿主呢，就是有点吵。从刚才开始您就一直在喊帝皇帝皇帝皇，帝皇在黄金王座上坐着呢听不见您喊。还有你跑就跑吧能不能别嚎了？你的嗓门比后面那些邪教徒还大，你是怕他们找不到你？】

越说越暴躁。

看起来也是个暴脾气。

但被一群混沌教徒和混沌邪物追杀的林恩暴怒：“你一个系统你有什么好叼的！！！有功能你就说，没功能你就闭嘴，不要打扰我逃命好吗！！！！！”

【宿主就不能先停下来吗？】

“停下来我就没命了你妈的！！你是不是想害死我然后再换一个宿主？！！”

【……行吧。】系统叹口气。

然后它就在林恩的面前展开了一个转盘面板，好像一个清晰的OLED屏幕，转盘上有密密麻麻的色块和词条。

【检测到宿主已穿越至战锤40k宇宙。】

【你好宿主，我是抽词条系统，这是我们的词条转盘。】

【系统名称：词条转盘。】

【系统功能：因果律，抽取到的词条会成真。】

【每十五天可抽取一次。解锁关键剧情点可额外抽取。】

【词条等级：白→绿→蓝→紫→金→彩。】

【当前词条装配上限：1（后续可解锁增加）。】

【首次抽取已就绪。是否现在抽取？】

林恩一边跑一边一目十行地扫过转盘上的信息。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lynn had never run so fast in her life.

Really, not exaggerating, really.

If you are caught up by the PE teacher, you will get kicked at most.

Just being chased by a Chaos Cultist with a knife^%&*#@...Ahhhhhhhh!!!

There are also chaotic evil things that can eat people.

Linn burst into tears while running away: "Warhammer 40k——!!! It's Warhammer 40k——!!!"

Warhammer!!!!!!

He wears Warhammer!!!!!!

When people were reading Hammer memes on the Internet, everyone said, "Hahaha, you are loyal!", "I am not loyal!", "Slaanesh!", "Get ready to join the gang! Justice from heaven!", "Your father is here, the traitor shall die!"...

That was when I was sitting at home, in front of the computer, with a Coke in my hand, the character could jump into the trap at any time, and I could turn off the game and return to reality at any time.

On this day, I stood in a dark cave, with seven or eight CultiSts and a group of grotesque chaotic evil creatures chasing me behind me. I didn’t know if there was any way ahead——

Come and try it, ahhhhhhhhh-!!!!!

CUltiSt came from behind with a smile, like the sound a cat makes before playing with a mouse.

"He can't run far."

"Seize him and offer him to the master——"

"Fresh flesh and blood..."

"Chase—!"

Linn burst into tears.

Just travel by light like this?!!No golden finger?!Where is his golden finger?!!!

"System! System, are you there——!!!"

In fact, he didn't have much hope when he called.

It would be fine if it really came out.

But just when he was running for his life in despair, a voice suddenly clicked in his head.

“Ding————!”

It was like someone gently struck a bell in his consciousness.

Then an illusory white panel unfolded before his eyes.

The system said: [...I have never seen a host that can howl like you.】

Linn couldn't believe it: "-What?!"

[Nothing, the system is not happy to serve you.】

The system changed to an official and polite tone with a fake smile and started to work: [The host is really the most capable host this system has ever seen, but it is a bit noisy.You have been calling Emperor, Emperor, Emperor, Emperor since just now. The Emperor is sitting on the golden throne and cannot hear you shouting.And just run, can you stop howling?Your voice is louder than the cultists behind you. Are you afraid that they can't find you?】

The more he spoke, the more irritable he became.

He also seems to have a bad temper.

But Lin En, who was being chased by a group of Chaos Cultists and Chaos Evil Creatures, was furious: "What do you have to say about your system!!! If it has a function, just say it. If it doesn't, just shut up. Don't disturb my escape, okay!!!!"

[Can’t the host stop first?】

"Stop and I'll be dead, damn you!! Do you want to kill me and then change the host?!!"

【...Okay.】The system sighed.

Then it unfolded a turntable panel in front of Linn, like a clear OLED screen, with dense color blocks and entries on the turntable.

[It has been detected that the host has traveled to the Warhammer 40k universe.】

[Hello host, I am the entry system, and this is our entry carousel.】

[System name: Entry carousel.】

[System function: Law of cause and effect, the extracted entries will come true.】

[Can be drawn once every fifteen days.Unlock key plot points for additional draws.】

[Entry level: white → green → blue → purple → gold → color.】

[Current entry assembly limit: 1 (can be unlocked and increased later).】

[The first extraction is ready.Do you want to extract now?】

Linn scanned the information on the turntable as he ran.
